description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.213 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Returns a concentration-risk score for an x402 pay_to wallet: HHI, unique payer count, top-payer share, persistence across scans, and a risk tier (LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH / CRITICAL). An agent uses this to assess whether an endpoint is a single-agent dependency before building a workflow that depends on it.
